name: Police Medal for Meritorious Service
benefit: **Tangible Benefits** - Award of Police Medal for Meritorious Service. - National recognition and prestige. - Entry of award in official service records. - Enhanced career prospects and credibility. - Recognition of long-term service excellence. **Mode of Disbursement** - Physical medal and citation conferred by the competent authority. - Awarded annually on national occasions.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a serving police officer or personnel of CAPFs/CPOs. 1. The applicant should have a clean service record without major penalties. 1. The applicant should demonstrate meritorious and consistent service. 1. The applicant should have a minimum service of 18 years. 1. The applicant should have ACRs available for the last 10 years. 1. The applicant should have at least 8 Very Good or above ACRs; at least 1 should be Outstanding. 1. The applicant should not have any average ACR during the review period. 1. The applicant should have at least 1 ACR after the Non-Initiation Certificate (NIC) period (if applicable). 1. The applicant should not have more than 1 missing ACR. 1. The applicant should ensure the last year ACR is available. 1. The applicant should be physically fit and fall under SHAPE 1 category; relaxation to SHAPE 2 may be given in exceptional cases. 1. The applicant should not have more than 3 nominations (for Group A officers). 1. The applicant should not have adverse vigilance or disciplinary issues.
